The speaker even qualifies the supply calculation as potentially inaccurate. The description presents the discussion as amateur opinion and says it does not promote cryptocurrency purchases or investments. It does include Bitvavo registration-and-reward wording, but the available evidence does not connect that promotion to deceptive conduct. Nor does the market discussion make a concrete request to purchase an investment or transfer funds.
